kaleidoscope.about: One slice of the picture, folded round and round. The slice starts at the middle and points right: turn it with angle.

mirror.about: One half of the picture shown on both sides, or one quarter in all four.

waves.about: The picture ripples like a flag in the wind.

ripple.about: Rings spreading from a point, as from a stone dropped in water.

wobble.about: The picture wobbles like jelly, or something seen under water.

swirl.about: The middle of the picture twisted round, like stirred paint.

fisheye.about: A bulge, as through a round lens. Below zero it pinches instead.

tunnel.about: The picture becomes the walls of a tunnel you are flying down.

tile.about: The picture repeated in rows and columns.

rgbSplit.about: Red and blue pulled apart, like a cheap lens or a bad signal.

hue.about: Every colour moved round the colour wheel. With speed, the colours keep turning.

saturate.about: More colour, or less: at 0 the picture is grey.

invert.about: A negative: every colour swapped for its opposite.

posterize.about: Only a few shades of each colour, like a poster.

duotone.about: Two colours only: one for the dark parts and one for the light.

colourCycle.about: Brightness becomes a colour from a palette, and the colours move round.

scanlines.about: Dark lines across the picture, as on an old screen.

crt.about: An old television: curved glass, lines, and thin stripes of red, green and blue.

glitch.about: A broken signal: blocks that jump sideways, a line that tears, a band of snow.

vignette.about: Dark corners, which draw the eye to the middle.

edges.about: Only the outlines, each in its own colour.

dots.about: Printed in dots, big where the picture is bright, as a comic or a newspaper is.

letters.about: The picture made of marks, as an old terminal would show it.

metaballs.about: Blobs that melt into each other when they meet: a lava lamp.

flow.about: Colour that folds and curls like ink in water.

droste.about: The picture inside itself, smaller each time, for ever. With a twist it winds in as a spiral.

rotozoom.about: The picture tiled, turning and zooming: an old demo-scene favourite.

glassTiles.about: Seen through a wall of glass blocks.

heatHaze.about: The shimmer of hot air rising.

caustics.about: The net of bright lines that sunlight makes on the floor of a pool.

shake.about: The whole picture shakes. Set strength when something hits, and let it fall away.

punch.about: A zoom in towards a point. Tie its strength to the beat.

tiltShift.about: A band in focus and the rest blurred, which makes a scene look like a tiny model.

lightRays.about: Rays of light streaming out from a point, through whatever is bright.

streaks.about: Long sideways flares from bright lights, as a film camera makes.

softFocus.about: A soft, dreamy haze over the bright parts.

smear.about: What was drawn is carried away on a slow current, like wet paint.

stutter.about: Only so many new pictures a second: the last one is held between them.

gradientMap.about: Brightness becomes a colour from a palette, dark to light.

thermal.about: A heat camera: cold is dark blue, hot is yellow and white.

nightVision.about: Green, grainy and bright in the dark, like a night-vision scope.

sepia.about: The warm brown of an old photograph.

threshold.about: Two colours and nothing between: dark or light.

solarize.about: The bright parts turned to their opposite, as in an over-exposed photograph.

colourBleed.about: Colours smeared sideways, as on old videotape.

rainbowEdges.about: Every edge in the picture drawn in rainbow colours.

dither.about: A few colours made to pass for many with a pattern of dots, as old computers did.

interlace.about: Every other line dark, swapping each frame, like old video.

emboss.about: Pressed into grey metal: only the bumps and hollows show.

stainedGlass.about: Pieces of coloured glass with dark lead between them.

crosshatch.about: Shaded with crossing pen lines: more lines where it is darker.

oil.about: Smoothed into patches of colour, like oil paint. Heavy: it looks at 36 places for every pixel.

dust.about: Specks and scratches, as on old film.

lightLeaks.about: Warm light creeping in from the sides, as in an old camera.

rain.about: Rain falling in front of the picture.

snow.about: Snow falling in front of the picture.

bokeh.about: Soft discs of coloured light drifting by: lamps out of focus.

fog.about: Drifting mist, thicker towards the bottom.

voronoi.about: Soft coloured cells that slowly shift.

moire.about: Two sets of rings crossing, making patterns neither has alone.

interference.about: Waves from four moving points, crossing.

aurora.about: The northern lights over a night sky.

fire.about: Flames rising from the bottom of the picture.

copperBars.about: Shining bars sliding up and down: a demo-scene classic.

checkerFloor.about: A chequered floor rushing towards you under a glowing horizon.

twister.about: A twisting four-sided bar, another demo-scene classic.

spectrumBars.about: The music as bars: low notes at the left, high at the right.

spectrumRing.about: The music as bars round a ring.

waveformRing.about: The sound's own wave, bent into a ring.

beatFlash.about: A flash of colour on each beat.

bassShake.about: The picture shakes with the bass.

glow.about: Bright things shine and spread light around them.

trails.about: What was drawn stays and fades. With zoom, spin and hue it becomes the classic screensaver tunnel.

lookAbout.arcade: The curved glass of an old arcade machine.
lookAbout.comic: A few flat colours, printed in dots.
lookAbout.underwater: Blue, wobbling and dim at the edges.
lookAbout.oldfilm: Brown, grainy and dark at the corners.
lookAbout.disco: A kaleidoscope whose colours keep turning.
lookAbout.c64: The colours of a 1980s home computer.
lookAbout.noir: Black and white, high contrast, grainy.
lookAbout.cinema: A film camera: flares, a narrow focus, grain.
lookAbout.terminal: Green marks on a dark screen.
